openings.claim: Separate sideways registration from strap compression, and convert the right-contact card into a manual retainer-clearance adjustment.
openings.delta: Use the four strips as two bolted, padded removable rim clamps with lateral registration faces; straps retain the hatch against separation. Keep clamps outside the marked opening and release straps to remove the hatch. Adverse card → ruler-confirmed right-contact height increase → technician raises the right retainer clearance by the measured increase before tensioning. The card remains in its assigned contact position. Ordinary strap retention and spacer clearance functions remain intact.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: obtain lateral resistance by increasing left-corner compression. Registration faces should carry the sideways load with lighter strap tension, while the rival risks reproducing opposite-corner lift. Under disturbance, clearance adjustment should avoid extra left compression while preserving horizontal registration. This predicts neither seal continuity nor established performance.
openings.probe: First confirm clamps can grip the actual rim without damage, straps reach their anchors, and every retaining part clears the opening upon release; otherwise stop before fabrication. Drill only strips and tether detachable parts using cord. Within ninety fabrication minutes, build one configuration. Use twelve closure/pull trials: ten numbered opening cycles, then a nominal false-signal trial with an intentionally premature clearance adjustment, then the final right-card trial with measured adjustment. Record horizontal displacement, opposite-corner lift, twenty-newton resistance, reopening time and visible seal condition. In the false-signal trial, cancel the adjustment when no height increase is measured. Reject if cancellation fails, straps escape, clamps slip, clearance cannot accommodate the card, displacement exceeds one millimetre, reopening exceeds thirty seconds, or new tears appear. Rival comparison uses the supplied three trials; additional rival effects remain unknown.
assumptions: Rim geometry permits padded external clamps and strap anchoring; neither accessibility nor reach is supplied.
Available strips and bolts permit registration and adjustable clearance without permanent deformation.
Twenty observation minutes permit twelve measurements; confirm before starting.
A ruler can resolve the relevant height change; otherwise disturbance detection is uninformative.

assessment: One probe proposal; deployment and reliable performance are unestablished. Missing rim geometry and strap reach are indispensable feasibility uncertainties. The disturbed trial must meet all outcome requirements except seal contact continuity.
